description: SciGRID gas (Scientific Grid Model of European Gas Transmission Networks) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems. The SciGRIDgas project provides an open-source gastransmission data model for Europe with geographical and metadata information originating from various publicly available sources. Coverage: Europe. The fact sheet classes it as: European Gas Transmission Network Model and Data (input and output). Sectors: Gas. Resolution: geography Individual gas transmission elements (pipelines, compressorstations, borderpoints etc.). Data availability is given as "all". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
